versions.name: Lost Pines Scout Reservation

features.note: two campfire rings with grassy banks and bench seating for campfires and skits
eight-lane archery range with equipment available to units
several bathhouses with restrooms and showers across camp
muzzle-loading rifles available as an add-on at the rifle range
forge in the living history area
eleven small cabins in the pines, each with four bunk beds
ten campgrounds with pavilions and power
three canoe racks with paddles and life jackets for use on the lake
outdoor chapel with a view of the lake and benches
the tallest freestanding wooden climbing tower in the state
nature and conservation program area
separate high and low COPE courses
dining hall with a smaller back room, plus a lodge hall
a fishing dock on the lake, with catfish and largemouth bass
flush toilets in the bathhouses
handicraft pavilion
medical lodge with laundry and isolation rooms
living history area with an old log cabin, a forge, and an axe-throwing area
nature and ecology pavilions
a do-it-yourself orienteering map of the property
pavilions at the waterfront, handicraft, scoutcraft, and cooking areas
many campsites are built on tent platforms
two pools available for unit use
a campsite set aside for provisional campers
smallbore rifle range
scoutcraft pavilion area
shotgun range using twenty-gauge shells
swimming in the pools and at the lakefront
axe-throwing area beside the living history cabin
lake frontage with a waterfront pavilion and dock
the property hosts a winter resident camp as well as a summer one

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp operated by Capitol Area Council, situated on the north shore of Lake Bastrop in the Lost Pines region of Bastrop, Texas.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
